title: AI + Product Design Morning Brief

highlights.headline: Figma's agent keeps absorbing the build step.
highlights.summary: [Figma](https://www.figma.com/release-notes/) now generates editable vector icons and illustrations, and its code layer agent reads prototype interactions (open beta).

highlights.headline: Always-on agents are the new product category.
highlights.summary: [Perplexity](https://www.perplexity.ai) launched Teammates, and [Meta](https://www.meta.ai) added voice, avatars and Spaces to its Muse agent.

highlights.headline: AI is now finding real security holes at scale.
highlights.summary: [Google DeepMind](https://deepmind.google) agents found weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA, and [OpenAI](https://openai.com) reported 948 local privilege-escalation exploits from a Linux kernel prototype.

highlights.headline: Agent tooling is consolidating.
highlights.summary: Meta absorbed Conductor and OpenAI is acquiring Pierre, the team behind libraries in the Codex app.

highlights.headline: Markets are jittery.
highlights.summary: The Nasdaq-100 fell 6.4% Thursday and chip supply is tightening as AI buyers crowd out other customers.

entries.headline: DeepMind agents weaken legacy RSA-1024
entries.summary: [Google DeepMind](https://deepmind.google) agents, guided by cryptanalysts, found two advances against 1024-bit RSA: signature forgery on short digests about 1,600x more efficient, and batch-factoring cost down about 30x. RSA-2048 is not affected ([source](https://cryptobriefing.com/google-deepmind-ai-rsa-1024-bit-weaknesses/)).
entries.why_it_matters: expert-guided agents now produce publishable cryptanalysis.

takeaway.label: For builders
takeaway.text: audit any system still using 1024-bit keys.

entries.headline: OpenAI finds a thousand fewer paths to root
entries.summary: An [OpenAI](https://openai.com) prototype scanned the Linux kernel, producing 2,308 candidates, reproducing 1,724 and building 948 local privilege-escalation exploits ([post](https://openai.com/index/a-thousand-fewer-paths-to-root/)).
entries.why_it_matters: defensive and offensive capability scale together.

takeaway.label: For builders
takeaway.text: expect agent-driven security review to become a standard CI step.

links.label: OpenAI finds a thousand fewer paths to root

entries.headline: Perplexity launches Teammates
entries.summary: [Perplexity](https://www.perplexity.ai) released always-on work agents for Max subscribers ($200/month) that can collaborate via Slack ([PCMag](https://au.pcmag.com/ai/120788/perplexity-teammates-ai-agent-help-you-work)).
entries.why_it_matters: the interface shifts from chat to a colleague that persists.

takeaway.label: For designers
takeaway.text: design for delegation, status and handoff, not prompts.

entries.headline: Meta Muse gets voice, avatars and Spaces
entries.summary: [Meta](https://www.meta.ai) added real-time voice with an animated avatar for US users ([Techbooky](https://techbooky.com/meta-adds-voice-and-expressive-avatars-to-muse-ai-agent)) and Spaces for ongoing projects ([Superpower Daily](https://superpowerdaily.com/posts/meta-adds-spaces-to-organize-ongoing-projects-with-its-muse-ai-agent)).
entries.why_it_matters: project-scoped memory plus voice is the template for consumer agents.

links.label: Meta Muse gets voice, avatars and Spaces

entries.headline: Anthropic publishes agent memory research
entries.summary: [Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com) described a three-layer memory model including idle-time "dreaming" consolidation ([research](https://www.anthropic.com/research/components-of-agent-memory)). Separately, [METR](https://metr.org/blog/2026-11-05-anthropic-ai-rd-acceleration-assessment/) estimates AI tooling drove about 80% of Anthropic's internal R&D speedup, though most evidence was redacted.

takeaway.label: For builders
takeaway.text: memory architecture is now a product design decision.

entries.headline: Thinking Machines ships Inkling 2 Small
entries.summary: [Inkling 2 Small](https://thinkingmachines.ai/news/inkling-2-small/) is a 594B MoE (17B active) scoring 86.3% on SWEBench Pro Hard. Apache 2.0 weights are promised next week.
entries.why_it_matters: a strong open-weight coding model is close.

entries.headline: Consolidation and friction
entries.summary: [Microsoft](https://www.microsoft.com) Research AI Frontiers, the group behind Autogen, was shut down per [John Langford](https://hunch.net/?p=13764006). [Conductor](https://www.conductor.build/announcement) joins Meta and closes signups, with cloud data deletion starting Nov 20. [OpenAI is acquiring Pierre](https://openai.com/index/openai-to-acquire-pierre/). [NVIDIA](https://www.nvidia.com) faces a House GOP briefing request on Nov 18 over Megaspeed ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/05/nvidia-jensen-huang-china-spy-congress.html)).

entries.headline: Figma agent now makes editable vectors
entries.summary: Nov 5: the [Figma](https://www.figma.com/release-notes/) agent generates editable vector illustrations and icons with style references and strokes, tied into Figma Motion.
entries.why_it_matters: icon sets that stay editable instead of raster dead ends.

links.label: Figma agent now makes editable vectors

entries.headline: Code layer agent reads prototype interactions
entries.summary: Nov 3: in open beta, the agent reads prototype connections and interactions, so behavior is specified by the design itself. Learn more in [Design together with code layers](https://www.figma.com/blog/design-together-with-code-layers/).

links.label: Code layer agent reads prototype interactions

entries.headline: Shaders GA, Weave models through MCP
entries.summary: Shaders are generally available with exports to 4096px and use in code layers. Weave image and video models (Seedance, Kling, Nano Banana) are reachable through the Figma MCP server. A Google Drive connector for the agent is available on all plans.

links.label: Shaders GA, Weave models through MCP

entries.headline: Specs in open beta
entries.summary: [Figma Specs](https://www.figma.com/blog/introducing-figma-specs/) is open beta on paid plans. [Build by design](https://www.figma.com/blog/build-by-design/) names 20 MCP partners including OpenCode and Junie by JetBrains.

entries.headline: AutoCua
entries.summary: MIT computer-use agent for macOS, Windows, Linux, browser, iOS and Android.

entries.headline: Scenario Agent Skills
entries.summary: Teaches coding agents to generate game and visual content via the Scenario MCP server.

entries.headline: Agent Autoloop
entries.summary: Runs CLI agents in a background loop with Slack, Discord or desktop notifications (macOS, Linux).

entries.headline: shim
entries.summary: Local-first harness for any model with MCP and Agent Skills.

entries.headline: verdict
entries.summary: Local semantic verifier for agent tool calls.
entries.audience: teams worried about destructive agent actions.

entries.headline: Arete-27B
entries.summary: Apache 2.0 fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B with better factuality.

entries.headline: T3 Code 0.1.7
entries.summary: Multi-agent coding app, 659 changes, adds Kiro beta.

entries.headline: Persistent agents
entries.summary: Teammates, Muse Spaces and Agent Autoloop all assume agents that run when you are away.

entries.headline: Design-to-code convergence
entries.summary: Figma code layers, MCP partners and prototype-aware agents blur the handoff.

takeaway.label: Learn
takeaway.text: to specify interaction in the prototype itself.

entries.headline: Agent safety UX
entries.summary: A [Codex issue](https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/59060) reports destructive actions and large costs (reporter's claims), and a professor reported [Claude deleting lecture notes](https://www.dexerto.com/entertainment/professor-returns-from-lunch-to-find-ai-deleted-years-worth-of-lecture-notes-3425652/) during a renumbering task. Guardrails, undo and dry-run previews are design problems.

entries.headline: Tooling consolidation
entries.summary: Big labs are buying the harness layer. Favor open, portable skills and MCP over single-vendor workflows.

entries.headline: Meta Muse Spaces
entries.summary: Project containers with background trackers make an agent feel like a workspace.

entries.headline: Figma one-click object selection
entries.summary: Select-area image editing reduces a masking task to a click.
entries.why_it_matters: it removes a skill barrier at the exact moment of intent.

entries.headline: Perplexity Teammates in Slack
entries.summary: Meeting people inside their existing channel avoids a new app to learn.

entries.headline: vercel-labs/agent-desktop
entries.summary: Rust desktop agent using OS accessibility trees instead of screenshots, with MCP. Gaining attention for speed and reliability over pixel-based control.

entries.headline: karpathy/nanochat
entries.summary: Minimal local-first chat stack, a learning favorite.

entries.headline: D4Vinci/Scrapling
entries.summary: Scraping engine with an MCP server and adaptive selectors.

entries.headline: JustVugg/colibri
entries.summary: Pure C inference that streams MoE experts from disk, aimed at running large models on modest hardware.

entries.summary: [scenario-labs/skills](https://github.com/scenario-labs/skills) (2,516 stars, +224 in a day) and AutoCua round out the week's risers.

entries.summary: A Tell HN on [Gemini saved-chat privacy](https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/13594961?hl=en) hit 634 points over Keep Activity training use. An [Ask HN on coding harnesses](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50366117) (154 points) is a useful comparison of real setups.

entries.headline: Prototype an interaction and let the code layer agent build it
entries.summary: Pick one screen, prototype a hover and click interaction in [Figma](https://www.figma.com), then let the code layer agent build it from the prototype. Compare the result to your intent and note which interactions it missed. Output: a short list of what to specify more explicitly.

dont_miss: Try the Figma [vector agent and code layer interaction reading](https://www.figma.com/release-notes/).
Skim the [Codex incident thread](https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/59060) for agent safety lessons.
